description: Result of a single Entity Update.

entityId.description: The ID of the updated entity.

failureMessage.description: Failure message for unknown and illegal errors.

failureCode.description: If the Entity update failed, a failure code will be included.  Null if the update was successful
failureCode.name: EntityUpdateFailureCode

enum.name: NOT_FOUND
enum.description: The specified entity could not be found.

enum.name: UNAUTHORIZED
enum.description: The user does not have permission to update the entity.

enum.name: CONCURRENT_UPDATE
enum.description: The entity was updated concurrently by another process.

enum.name: ILLEGAL_ARGUMENT
enum.description: The update request contained invalid or illegal arguments.

enum.name: UNKNOWN
enum.description: An unknown error occurred during the update.
